CHART — COMPACT UNITS + MAX-2-SERIES    
────────────────────────────────────    
                                        
The y-axis learns compact units (45.5M) 
so a large-value chart keeps a narrow   
gutter, and a chart renders at most the 
first two series — the third is dropped 
from the plot, the legend, AND the auto-
scale.
